description: This file implements doubly linked list operations for the libwebsockets project's core library, including functions to add, remove, and iterate over list elements, as well as search and diagnostic functions.

methods.name: int lws_dll2_is_detached(const struct lws_dll2 * d)
methods.description: Checks if a doubly linked list element is detached from any list by verifying its owner and next/prev pointers.

methods.name: int lws_dll2_foreach_safe(struct lws_dll2_owner * owner,void * user,int (* cb)(struct lws_dll2 * d,void * user))
methods.description: Iterates safely over all elements in a list, executing a callback for each element.

methods.name: void lws_dll2_add_head(struct lws_dll2 * d,struct lws_dll2_owner * owner)
methods.description: Adds an element to the beginning of the list.

methods.name: void lws_dll2_add_before(struct lws_dll2 * d,struct lws_dll2 * after)
methods.description: Inserts an element before a specified element in the list.

methods.name: void lws_dll2_add_tail(struct lws_dll2 * d,struct lws_dll2_owner * owner)
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the list.

methods.name: void lws_dll2_remove(struct lws_dll2 * d)
methods.description: Removes an element from its list.

methods.name: void lws_dll2_clear(struct lws_dll2 * d)
methods.description: Clears the owner, prev, and next pointers of an element.

methods.name: void lws_dll2_owner_clear(struct lws_dll2_owner * d)
methods.description: Resets the list owner, including head, tail, and count.

methods.name: void lws_dll2_add_sorted_priv(lws_dll2_t * d,lws_dll2_owner_t * own,void * priv,int (* compare3)(void * priv,const lws_dll2_t * d,const lws_dll2_t * i))
methods.description: Inserts an element into a list based on a comparison function and a private data pointer.

methods.name: void lws_dll2_add_sorted(lws_dll2_t * d,lws_dll2_owner_t * own,int (* compare)(const lws_dll2_t * d,const lws_dll2_t * i))
methods.description: Inserts an element into a list based on a comparison function.

methods.name: void * _lws_dll2_search_sz_pl(lws_dll2_owner_t * own,const char * name,size_t namelen,size_t dll2_ofs,size_t ptr_ofs)
methods.description: Searches the list for a string matching the given name and length, returning a pointer to the reference.
